sentences.japanese: 君は偉いことをやったね。
偉い人は身なりを気にしない。
sentences.english: A great man doesn't care about his appearance.

sentences.japanese: あの会社はみんなお偉いさんの肩書きばかりで、船頭多くて船進まずだ。
sentences.english: Everybody in that company is either a vice-president or a senior vice-president; they're all chiefs and no Indians.

sentences.japanese: あの偉い坊さんを見ろよ。
彼は自分では偉いつもりでいるが、実際はとるに足らぬ人だ。
sentences.english: He thinks he is somebody, but really he is nobody.
